description: This source file implements utility functions for handling HTTP/2 server push in the quiche QUIC protocol library, including extracting promised URLs from headers and validating them.

classes.name: SpdyServerPushUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling HTTP/2 server push URL extraction and validation.

methods.name: GetPromisedUrlFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts the promised URL from HTTP/2 headers if valid, based on RFC 7540 and RFC 7231 rules.

methods.name: GetPromisedHostNameFromHeaders
methods.description: Returns the hostname from the promised URL extracted from headers.

methods.name: PromisedUrlIsValid
methods.description: Checks if the promised URL from headers is valid and well-formed.

methods.name: GetPushPromiseUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for server push based on scheme, authority, and path, validating each component.
